text:
maya: Quick speaker-brief thread 10am rehearsal today. Need: final abstracts, 2 one-liners for social, benchmark callouts for slide 6, and QA routing. Who can confirm? @zara for PR copy.
aj: I can send the one-liners. Benchmark callout on slide 6 should mention 3x latency reduction vs baseline and 40% cost/unit. Use \"3x faster at 1/2 the cost\" as the headline.
zara: Got it. I'll draft two tweet-length lines. Also need speaker bios (max 40 words) and headshots. Maya, are bios in the shared drive?
maya: Yes, drive link in doc. I'll tidy bios to 40w. Reminder: embargo until publish time 2026-04-15 10:00 PT. No quotes out of thread.
sam: Ops check: staging demo token will be valid for rehearsal + buffer. Demo fallback clip uploaded to gs://rw-webinar/fallbacks/brief.mp4. I'll rehearse playback at T-20. Also setting an analytics tag: utm_campaign=serve-webinar-q2.
kim: QA routing: audience Qs go to Slido, we triage top 3 to panel. Post-webinar leads route to SDR queue \"Webinar-Q2\" with lead score >=50. Can opsbot create routing rule?
opsbot: rule-create: when form_submission=webinar AND score>=50 -> route=SDR:Webinar-Q2; status=created :white_check_mark:
zara: Drafts done. Maya, want me to A/B test two headlines on a small ad set?
maya: Good idea but schedule after landing page live. For now focus speaker prep + run-of-show. Run-of-show snippet: T-45 panel join, T-10 mic check, 0 go-live, demo at 16m, benchmark slide at 10m, Q&A 36-50m.
aj: For slide 6 data please include methodology note: \"1M token sample, mixed batch, p95 latency\". Keep it short under slide.
maya: Everyone rehearse with slide numbers not names. Zara, send social one-liners and bio edits by 10:30 so I can approve before rehearsal.
sam: Confirming rehearsal at 10:00. I'll post staging token in DM.
kim: I'll prepare the Slido moderation cue and share panelist order for Qs.
maya: Thanks. Final: add checkbox in speaker prep doc for recording consent and clip permission. We'll need signed consent before publish.
